Create tasks, restart uvicorn, GET /tasks returns all previously created tasks
DB file exists on disk at expected path after first run
evidence: pytest tests/ -v -> 9 passed (test_task_persists_after_simulated_restart: two separate TestClient lifespan cycles against the same DB file, plus all prior tests still green)
Manual: curl POST a task, killed the uvicorn process, confirmed tasks.db exists on disk (12288 bytes), restarted uvicorn, curl GET /tasks returned the same task unchanged
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md documents DB_PATH (repo root tasks.db, TODOLIST_DB_PATH override, gitignored)
features.agent_notes: No implementation change needed — backend/database.py already used a real on-disk sqlite3 file (not :memory:) since feat-001, so persistence across restarts was already correct by construction. This feature's work was writing the test that proves it and documenting the DB location.

evidence: pytest tests/ -v -> 12 passed (test_filtering_active_tasks_excludes_completed, test_filtering_completed_tasks_excludes_active, test_sorting_by_created_at_returns_ascending_creation_order, plus all prior tests still green)
Playwright screenshots: clicked Active -> shows only 'Buy milk', hides completed 'Walk the dog'; clicked Completed -> inverse; clicked All -> shows both; console --errors empty

features.agent_notes: GET /tasks now takes filter (all|active|completed) and sort (created_at) query params, composed via an allow-listed WHERE/ORDER BY (never raw-interpolating the query param values themselves, so no injection risk). sort=due_date intentionally not implemented here — no due_date column exists yet; feat-007 will add an elif branch to the same order_by logic. Frontend: new FilterBar component (filter buttons + sort select, one option for now), App.tsx now holds filter/sort state and refetches from the server on any mutation so the displayed list always reflects the active filter (e.g. checking a task complete removes it from the Active view immediately).

features.agent_notes: backend/models.py validates due_date as ISO 8601 via date.fromisoformat in a shared field_validator (invalid format -> 422 automatically). backend/database.py adds a nullable due_date column. list_tasks' order_by branch extended with sort=due_date -> 'due_date IS NULL, due_date' (nulls last). Refactored the 4 duplicated Task(...) row-construction blocks into a single _row_to_task helper since this feature touched all of them. Note: TaskUpdate.due_date follows the same only-provided-fields pattern as title/completed, which means a due date can be set or changed via PATCH but not explicitly cleared back to null in this implementation (not required by the spec/tests) — flagged for awareness, not fixed since untested behavior wasn't added speculatively. Frontend: date input on TaskForm, due date + overdue (red) styling on TaskItem (incomplete AND due_date < today), 'Due date' option added to FilterBar's sort select.
